verdict.rationale: Jules takes a submitted task, plans it, modifies code in a VM and opens a PR. One community report says a non-engineer customer now makes their own PRs with it, though only about 75% of the time. However, nothing in the evidence shows Jules accepting a mockup or design file as input, and several users report it needs babysitting and back-and-forth fixing. missing for 10: documented mockup/design (image or Figma) input, evidence of design-to-UI fidelity, reliable non-engineer end-to-end success without review.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can go from a mockup or design to a working implementation without an engineering handoff

citations.quote: Jules runs in a virtual machine where it clones your code, installs dependencies, and modifies files.
Jules creates a PR of the changes. Approve the PR, merge it to your branch, and publish it on GitHub.
taught the customer to use Jules. They make their own PRs now, Railway spins up an environment with the changes. It works like 75% of the time.
